vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: ios-simulator
Version: 0.1.2

The skill bundle provides a Node.js wrapper for `xcrun simctl` and `idb` to automate iOS Simulator workflows. The `SKILL.md` provides clear instructions and transparently categorizes commands by safety tier. The `ios-sim.mjs` script uses standard Node.js modules and executes external binaries (`xcrun`, `idb`) with arguments that are either hardcoded, validated, or explicitly passed to the simulator/app. There is no evidence of intentional malicious behavior, data exfiltration, persistence, or prompt injection against the agent. All actions are aligned with the stated purpose of iOS simulator automation.
